scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:vs-code
scripts.build:vs-code: npm run sync:ts-plugin && cd packages/vs-code && npm run build
scripts.publish:all: npm publish --workspaces --access public && npm run publish:vscode
scripts.publish:vscode: npm run sync:ts-plugin && cd packages/vs-code && npx vsce publish --no-dependencies
